errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени в кръга в низходящ ред по големина, започвайки от най-големия вляво надолу.
errors.evidence: The statement claims the sectors are arranged in descending order. This is only true if they are read in a counter-clockwise direction. Read in the standard clockwise direction starting from the largest slice (31.0%), the order is 31.0%, 4.8%, 16.7%, 21.4%, 26.2%, which is not descending. The description does not specify the direction, making the statement about the arrangement misleading and factually incorrect.
